name: print-social-where-creative-ideas-grow-poster-yellow-sun-geometric
title: 'Where Creative Ideas Grow' poster with a yellow sun burst, an eye-in-frame icon and a zigzag grid strip
whatItIs: A navy-bordered white poster with a yellow starburst sun, bold navy 'Where Creative Ideas Grow' headline, an italic 'Abstract.' label, a stacked yellow-framed eye illustration, a red zigzag line, a row of red triangles, and a navy grid strip with an arch, dot and sun-face shapes.
whatItMeans: Playful and confident; Bauhaus-style primary shapes and a whimsical eye icon make abstract creativity feel concrete and fun.
techniques: Stack simple geometric icons (eye, sun, arch) as content blocks.
Use a starburst shape as a bold focal accent.
Keep the palette to a few bold primary and secondary colours.

vocabulary.definition: A radiating spiky shape, often used to suggest energy or a sun.
Simple geometric forms like circles, triangles and squares.
